basics.name: Ayush Kumar
basics.label: Machine Learning Researcher
basics.summary: Machine Learning Researcher specializing in Deep Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI system development. Currently pursuing a Specialist Degree in Mathematics and Computer Science at Tomsk State University. Achieved Top 28 Global Ranking in Wunder Fund RNN Challenge for HFT market state forecasting.

work.name: Wunder Fund RNN
work.summary: Designed and deployed a production-grade inference pipeline for High-Frequency Trading (HFT) market state forecasting.
highlights: Achieved Top 30 Global Ranking in the Wunder Fund Challenge
Engineered custom INT8 Dynamic Quantization pipeline in PyTorch, reducing model memory footprint by 75%
Architected 'Hive Mind' Ensemble with Deep Residual GRUs and LSTMs with Mish activations and Squeeze-and-Excitation blocks
Implemented robust MLOps practices including automated artifact serialization, custom loss functions (Huber, Pinball), and rigorous cross-validation
